nom: Caudalie Vinopure Acne Serum with Salicylic Acid - 30 mL

avis.texte: My skin is pretty sensitive, and I'm nearing middle aged and I've been breaking out more than usual. BP is great for spot treatment but it's kind of overkill and can be really irritating on my skin. I wasn't sure if Salicylic Acid would be beneficial for me, but I generally enjoy Caudalie products and figured I would give it a shot. So far, this has been fantastic. Using it consistently during the periods of the month where I'm having breakout, it really speeds up recovery of blemishes, and alternating it with other products throughout the month, it seems to really help my overall skin texture and pores. The BHA/PHA seems to be gentle enough to exfoliate without irritation, and my skin loves niacinamide. It feels like this has been helping with my barrier, which is fantastic given aforementioned sensitivity. This product is way more versatile than just a straight forward acne serum. The texture is light, and layers well under other products. The texture is lovely, little bit thin gel serum-y that dries down well (not sticky). It does play well during the daytime under makeup with a light moisturizer, though my preference is without/during evening. I do lean dry so in this case less is more. My only reservation here is that rather than the usual Caudalie fragrance this one is more herbal, while fresh, it's just as strong as the their other scents. Kind of a pepperminty lemongrassy rosemary situation that, while not unpleasant, can feel like a lot at times. The fragrance is pre
Clean product that works so well. What more can I say? I love this whole line. Clean. Yields results. Doesnt irritate my skin. All around 10/10

avis.titre: Great overall but did expire quickly
avis.texte: I’ve been using this serum for a while now and overall I have no complaints. It’s not too strong for my skin and it doesn’t cause breakouts. I like that it has a soft exfoliant but is still gentle for sensitive skins. The texture is light so it will work well regardless of your skincare routine. I took away one star because the item expired three months after I received it. That means you would have to start using it immediately upon purchase, and daily, to avoid using expired product on your face.

avis.titre: Very effective spot treatment for mild hormonal acne
avis.texte: I have been using this as a spot treatment for acne for the past few months and it works very well! Caudalie products agree with my sensitive skin and have no smell at all (which I'm very sensitive to). This dries pimples well and typically decreases the size of blemishes overnight. I put on in the evenings before going to sleep and 9/10 times I've used have woken up with my blemish almost gone. For reference, I'm dealing with small hormonal acne flair ups but not cystic acne so I can't speak to this product's effectiveness at dealing with more significant issues.

avis.titre: El mejor serum que he probadoEl mejor serum que he probado
avis.texte: Si pudiera darle un 10 estrellas se las daría porque me deja la piel brillante pero no es un brillo grasoso es un brillo como si la piel fuera de plástico como de una muñeca, sé que esta marca es lo máximo pero este producto de esta marca es lo mejor que he probado de ser un de Skincare

avis.titre: A great product, but watch the expiration date!A great product, but watch the expiration date!
avis.texte: Caudalie is a brand I have trusted for 15+ years, after discovering it at a "big box beauty" store and paying full retail on repeat (it started with the Caudalie Cru line which is heavenly!). They have a variety of lines and admittedly over my years as my skin has changed from my 20s into my 40s, I've tried most of them! This is an acne product that you can use to spot treat, but I also kind of bulk apply it across my nose and my (recessed) chin which tend to get a lot of blackheads. I use sparingly but am thankful it doesn't burn - but I tend to alternate application days (and do use a light therapy mask on my off days). I like medicinal herbal products and find Caudalie's a lot lighter than many brands like AVEDA. The major ingredient here is salicylic acid which you can absolutely find in cheaper products- but I am old enough to know "you get what you pay for" and find many mainstream products too harsh (they work but they strip my skin which introduces unwanted redness) - this is gentler IMO. I did deduct a star because it's a recent order (I did wait a few weeks before reviewing so I could know what I was talking about!), but the expiration is June 2026. That's an unacceptable expiration to me because there's no way most buyers would use even half the bottle that face (unless they had body acne too?), so I deducted a star because that lowers how I'd perceive value. It was very disappointing though, and seems very off from my usual Caudalie experiences so I'm not sure wha

I received a bottle with a best by date of 6/26 which is less than 90 days from now. It looks like Vinopure Blemish Treatment's active ingredient doesn't have a very long shelf life, and these have a one year best by date after production (my batch code is 146836). At this rate this product will expire before I finish the bottle, which is disappointing. On a positive note, I did not experience any peeling or excessive dryness from using this serum. It IS heavily perfumed, which is a strange choice in a blemish serum. This smells almost of menthol, and I can smell it for about 40 minutes on my face after applying. It is not a nice smell. From the ingredients, it does appear that this product will deliver as intended. It's main powerhouse ingredient is salicylic acid (it's oil soluble so it works inside of pores to reduce clogs). Salicylic acid is a pretty strong exfoliant, so please please please make sure you're applying sunscreen while using this (you always should wear sunscreen anyway - but especially so when using salicylic acid). This also includes niacinamide, which has a dual action purpose of supporting skin barrier and regulating oil production. I love to see niacinamide as an ingredient. I'm a bit disappointed that at this price point that Caudalie is sending out items with such a close expiry. Especially in a product with an active ingredient. It makes me hesitant to buy other Caudalie products on Amazon.

The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly without leaving any sticky or greasy layer behind. It layers well with other products and doesn’t pill, which makes it easy to use both morning and night. I was expecting something a little harsher because of the salicylic acid, but this feels surprisingly gentle. What stood out most is how it handles congestion. I noticed fewer clogged pores and a smoother overall texture after about a week of regular use. It also helped calm down active breakouts faster than usual, without over-drying my skin. My skin can get reactive with acne treatments, but this didn’t cause irritation or tightness. There’s a slight natural scent from the ingredients, but it’s not overpowering and fades quickly after application. This works best as a steady, consistent treatment rather than a spot fix. It’s more about keeping skin clear and refined over time instead of delivering an overnight miracle.

avis.titre: A high-quality luxury serum for acne
avis.texte: I loooove Caudalie and was excited to try this because it’s a fantastic luxury brand that uses natural ingredients. The bottle has a matte and soft finish that feels very high-end and unique compared to standard glass. The serum itself has a typical gel texture, and it’s easy to spread. I'm in my late 30s with oily skin and fine lines, and I appreciate a serum that doesn't feel heavy or sticky. The scent of this product is so entirely unique and makes the application feel like a spa visit. It’s hard to pin down exactly what it is, but it smells piney and fresh, maybe with a bit of tea tree and lavender mixed in. It's very clean and stays pleasant while you're working it into your skin. Being someone who’s tried a lot of mid to high-range skincare, I can tell this is a quality formulation. Just a pump or 2 is all you need. It didn't cause any irritation for the first couple days while I was using it morning and night, which was a relief since my skin isn't overly sensitive. By the third day, my skin was definitely a bit dry, but to be fair, the bottle mentions that might happen. I just took a short break and focused on my usual moisturizers for a bit, and when I started it again I used the sandwich method where I put moisturizer on both before and after it. It really helped clear up the small amount of hormonal acne I had without any stinging or peeling. Overall, this is a fantastic item for a luxury treatment that actually delivers on its promises. I’d recommend it to someone

avis.titre: Love Caudalie and love their Vinopure line!
avis.texte: I have quite a few Caudalie products and am such a huge fan, and I’ve been using the cleanser, toner and spot treatment from the Vinopure line so I was excited to try out this Caudalie Vinopure Ac.ne Treatment! I have fairly sensitive skin and have had no adverse reactions. There is a scent to it, but no added fragrance / perfume. It’s from natural oils in the ingredients. I get a tea tree scent but that’s not an ingredient haha so it must be a mixture of the ingredients that gives me that scent. This serum has been doing wonders to my skin! I love this serum targets ALL types of ac.ne and also helps prevent new bumps from forming! It’s been super effective for my skin, I’ve noticed such a difference since using it! A little goes a very long way as well, so this bottle will last me a long time! I was expecting it to dry my skin out, but it doesn’t at all! It actually is quite hydrating and feels so nice and cool on my skin! Absolutely worth every penny! Me and my skin love this serum and Caudalie’s whole Vinopure line!

I am absolutely thrilled with the results from the Caudalie Vinopure Acne Serum. Caudalie is such a respected, high-quality brand, and this product proves exactly why they are worth the investment. While it is a premium price point, it is worth every penny because it is incredibly effective and has been so great for my skin. The gel texture feels amazing and absorbs quickly without leaving any sticky residue. What I love most is that it acts as an acne "fighter" while still being safe for my skin barrier. Usually, products with salicylic acid can be stripping, but this formula is surprisingly gentle and has been wonderful for my sensitive areas. It has visibly tightened my pores and improved my overall skin texture significantly. The clinical results really speak for themselves, and I noticed a huge difference in my breakouts within the first week. It’s a powerful combination of BHA and PHA that unclogs everything while keeping the skin hydrated. If you are looking for a long-lasting solution that actually supports your skin while clearing it up, I cannot recommend this enough. It is a staple in my routine now. HIGHLY recommend!

avis.titre: Product is nice, expiration date on my bottle was 6/2026.
avis.texte: I've been using this for about a week along with my son. He has been struggling with acne lately (he's 10 and very active and starting to go through puberty). I love the container, it is solid and luxurious, just as you would expect from Caudalie (I have used many of their products in the past and loved them). So far it is hard to tell if it is making much difference. However, he does seem to have less acne than previously. He thinks it is helping enough to keep him using it, so that is huge. We have both kept all of our other products the same. My skin looks the same, I have combination skin that is sometimes sensitive, and it looks the same as before I started using it (but to be fair I don't currently have blemishes, so I didn't expect a big difference for me.) I do have to say, I was surprised to see that it has an expiration date for this year (6/2026) which is only three months from now. I'm hoping that I just got a late batch, but a heads up as that is barely enough time to get it all used even if you use it every day!

I always appreciate when pump bottles have a locking feature, and this one does, which makes it much easier for travel or storing. I have fairly oily skin and noticed a slight tingle for a few seconds after applying. Nothing uncomfortable at all, just that feeling where you can tell the product is doing something. It absorbs nicely and doesn’t leave my skin feeling greasy. There is a scent that’s a little hard to place. The formula includes rosemary, so I suspect that may be part of it mixed with the other ingredients. It’s not strong or unpleasant, just noticeable at first. This isn’t something I personally use every day, but more of a couple-times-a-week product when I want to keep blemishes under control. It fits nicely into that role and works well alongside the rest of my routine.

I’ve had a good experience with the Caudalie Vinopure Acne Treatment Serum. The formula feels lightweight and absorbs quickly, making it easy to incorporate into a morning or evening skincare routine. It contains salicylic acid to help unclog pores and treat breakouts, along with gluconolactone (PHA) for gentle exfoliation and niacinamide to help refine the look of pores. What I like most is that it feels effective but still gentle. Some acne treatments can be very drying, but this one seems to help with blemishes while still supporting the skin barrier. My skin texture looks smoother and more balanced with consistent use, and it works well both as a full-face treatment or as a spot treatment when needed. One downside is the price. At about $49 at the time of this review, it is definitely on the expensive side for a 30 mL serum. That said, the formula feels high quality, and a little goes a long way. Overall, it’s a well-formulated acne serum that helps address breakouts while still being gentle enough for regular use.

The Caudalie Vinopure Acne Treatment serum has been a nice addition to my routine for keeping occasional breakouts under control. The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly, so it layers well with other skincare products and doesn’t leave a sticky or heavy feeling on the skin. What I appreciate most is that it’s fairly gentle, even on my sensitive skin. Some salicylic acid treatments can feel harsh or drying, but this one seems well balanced. It helps calm and reduce small blemishes without leaving my skin irritated or overly tight afterward. It also works well as a preventative treatment. Using it consistently on areas where I tend to get breakouts—mainly my T-zone—has helped keep congestion and small spots from developing in the first place. The 30 mL bottle is a typical serum size, but because you only need a small amount per application, it lasts a while. Overall, it’s a lightweight, effective acne treatment that strikes a nice balance between being active enough to help with blemishes while still being gentle enough for sensitive skin.

avis.titre: Thoughtful formulation of great array of ingredients
avis.texte: I love Caudalie products for several reasons. First and foremost, they're effective.... But equally important, their formulations include well researched ingredients and focus heavily on natural ingredients. The Vinopure acne serum highlights the active ingredient of salicylic and alpha hydroxy acids, which have a long track record as acne ingredients that work well. But it's the complementary ingredients that I find most interesting. Things like peppermint oil, several flower oil derivatives and rosemary. Mother Nature nature for the large supportive role. The serum smells fabulous, too...rosemary. Application of refreshing and cooling. No irritation and not overly drying. Excellent ingredients, thoughtfully formulated with measurable results. Well worth every penny and then some.

This is Caudalie salicylic acid serum. The serum comes in a pump bottle that is easy to dispense. It has a light fresh scent that is unique to the brand. The scent is very light and goes away quickly after applying so it doesn't bother me at all. The serum has salicylic acid, which is to treat blemishes, it's recommended to use this in small amount first then gradually increase to prevent dryness. I've used salicylic acid before so it didn't cause any dryness on my skin. I used it at night before bed with my night cream and my skin was soft and hydrated in the morning. I did not experience any irritation with this product. It's a good serum and it comes in a reputable brand. I'd highly recommend
